legal.priv1: {controlador} is the controller of the personal data processed in this service, under Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018, LGPD). To talk about your data, use {contato}.
legal.priv2: Your email and, if you give it, your name. We also keep the date and version of the texts you accepted, a short identification of your browser and an irreversible code derived from your IP address, used for security. We do not ask for documents, phone number or address.
legal.priv3: To identify you, allow access to the video catalog, send the access link when email sending is on, protect the service against abuse and meet legal obligations.
legal.priv4: Processing relies on your consent, given when you accept these texts, and on providing the service you asked for. You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account.
legal.priv5: With the providers that make the service work, as processors: hosting and database (Cloudflare), the video provider and, when email sending is on, the email service. We do not sell your data.
legal.priv6: We keep your data {retencao}. Expired sessions, links and invitations are deleted automatically. When you delete your account, we erase your access data.
legal.priv7: You can confirm that we process your data, access it, correct it, export it and delete it. In My account you download your data as JSON and delete the account whenever you want. For other requests, use {contato}.
legal.priv8: We use a single, strictly necessary cookie that keeps you signed in. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
legal.priv9: If this text changes, we will show the new version and ask you to accept again.

legal.termos3: You look after your email and your access link. Whoever gets your link signs in as you. Tell {contato} if you think someone used your account.
legal.termos4: The catalog content belongs to {controlador} or to whoever licensed it. To report content or ask for its removal, write to {contato}.

telas.homeAjudaTexto: A notice or introduction in text, per language.
telas.homeClasseCurta: Short (the series appear only in this row)
telas.homeClasseInstitucional: Institutional (out of the per-series rows and the "up to 5 minutes" row)
telas.homeClasseSelecao: Selection (the series stay in the per-series rows)
telas.homeColecoesSub: Free groups of series that become rows on the home page. A "short" or "institutional" collection takes its series out of the other rows.
telas.homeConfirmaPadrao: Return the home, collections and model to the default? The change goes into the draft.
telas.homeConfirmaRemover: Remove the "{tipo}" block? The change goes into the draft.
telas.homeConfirmaRemoverColecao: Remove this collection? Blocks that point to it stop showing titles. The change goes into the draft.

telas.homeFicamDeFora.one: {n} title does not appear in any row of the home page.
telas.homeFicamDeFora.other: {n} titles do not appear in any row of the home page.

telas.homeFicamDeForaAjuda: Keep a "Everything else" block with the gather-every-title option on. Missing:
telas.homeGarantir: Gather every title that no other row shows
telas.homeImagem: Image: site file or https address
telas.homeLink: Link: #/... on the site or https://...
telas.homeMinimo: Minimum titles for the row to appear
telas.homeModeloDica: In standalone mode the home does not show "S1 E3", hides the Series page and the default list starts with new titles.
telas.homeModeloSeriado: Episodic: series with seasons and episodes
telas.homePrevia: How it looks on the home page
telas.homePreviaBusca: Search field in the middle of the home page
telas.homePreviaSub: The list the site draws now, with the draft applied.
telas.homeSemFileira: Nothing to show now: no title fits, or the block depends on who is watching.
telas.homeSub: The order of what appears on the home page. Change the blocks, check the preview below and publish through the usual draft.
telas.homeTags: Tags (comma separated): titles with any of them join
telas.homeTitulosPorIdioma: Title in each language (empty: the usual name)
telas.homeUltimoBloco: The home needs at least one block.
telas.homeVoltarAoPadraoDica: Clears the block list, collections and model chosen here: config/site.json applies and, without it, the usual home.
telas.metadadosCapaELegendaA: Metadata, cover and subtitles, on the right
telas.mostrandoAsPrimeiras: Showing the first {n} of {total} changes in this publication.
telas.motivoExtensao: the file extension is not the expected one
telas.motivoHostNaoPermitido: the host is not allowed: add it to video.hlsGenerico.hostsPermitidos in the configuration

telas.naoAparecemNaChegada.one: {n} title does not appear on the home page.
telas.naoAparecemNaChegada.other: {n} titles do not appear on the home page.

telas.navegueAteOQuadro: scrub to the frame and use it. Pausing helps you land on it.
telas.nenhumTituloComPendenciaAgora: No titles with a pending issue right now.
telas.nenhumaPublicacaoRegistradaAindaO: No publication recorded yet. The history starts at the first publication after this version of the site.
telas.noLugarDaImagemQuando: In place of the image, when the title has no cover.
telas.noRascunhoOuJaGravado: in the draft or already saved
telas.oArquivoVaiDoNavegador: The file goes straight from your browser to the video provider, via TUS. You can switch screens on the desk: the upload continues. Just do not close the tab.
telas.oBunnyCodificaEmFila: The provider encodes — while queued, the video embeds but does not play
telas.oBunnyNaoInformouO: the provider did not report the new cover’s name, and the site may be missing it: run sincronizar-capas.mjs
telas.oCatalogoMudouEmOutra: The catalog changed on another screen. Click Save again.
telas.oPeDeTodaPagina: The footer of every page. The “Administration” link is always there.
telas.oQueSoOSuperadmin: What only the superadmin can do:
telas.oRodapeEOsCinco: The footer and the site’s five empty states. An empty field shows the default text, which is what is written in grey.
telas.oSuperadminVoceEA: The superadmin — you — is the environment password and does not appear in this list. Each account signs in with a username and password and can do only what is checked. Removing a permission or changing the upload limit ends the person’s open session on their next request.
telas.oTituloEntraNoCatalogo: The title is added to the catalog now, unpublished. Publishing goes through the draft, and only once encoding is done.
telas.oVideoAindaNaoCarregou: the video has not loaded yet
telas.oVideoJaEstaNoSeuServidor: The video is already on your server: paste the HLS playlist address (.m3u8) below. The site checks the address and the playlist before adding the title.
telas.osMetadadosAbremAquiQuando: The metadata opens here when the video finishes uploading. Meanwhile the desk stays free: you can edit other titles.
telas.osMetadadosAbremAquiQuandoEndereco: The metadata opens here once the address is checked.
telas.passoColeOEndereco: Paste the playlist address that your server delivers
telas.passoOSiteConfereOPlaylist: The site checks the address and reads the playlist
telas.passoSobeParaOProvedor: The file goes up to the video provider
telas.playlistIncompleto: The playlist is not complete yet (the end marker is missing): wait for the server to finish before publishing.
telas.playlistInvalido: The address responds, but the content is not an HLS playlist.
telas.porNoArPeloRascunho: Publish, via the draft, once encoding is done
telas.protocoloDeEnvioNaoSuportado: the upload protocol “{protocolo}” is not supported by this screen
telas.quemEntraEmCadaPrateleira: Which titles go on each shelf is decided by the code. The name, the order and hiding are your choice — and an empty field goes back to the default.
telas.quemEstaUsandoAMesa: Who is using the desk in this browser.
telas.resumoTabela: {noAr} live · {fora} unpublished · rev {rev}. The header sorts; click a row to edit on the right, and double-click to open the title page on the site.
telas.salvarDerrubaASessaoAberta: Saving ends this account’s open session.
telas.seloVermelhoNoCartaoDe: Red badge on the card of a title without a video.
telas.semVideoNoBunnyNao: No video at the provider: there is nowhere to store the cover.
telas.semVideoNoBunnyNao2: No video at the provider: there is nothing to take a cover from.
telas.tambemDaParaDecidirPelos: You can also decide using the “Pending issue” and “Live” fields in the right-hand panel.
telas.temAlteracaoNoRascunho: has a change in the draft
telas.tituloDaBuscaSemResultado: Heading for a search with no results. The searched term goes on the line below.
telas.tituloDoLinkDeUma: Heading for a link to a title page that does not exist or was taken down.
telas.trocarOVideoDeUm: replace a title’s video, change chapters and frame rate, remove a title from the catalog and manage accounts. These are the fields that come from scripts.
telas.videoCriado: video created: {id} (the signature is valid until {ate})
telas.videoEnviadoPreenchaOsMetadados: Video uploaded. Fill in the metadata on the right.
telas.voltarOCatalogoParaEsta: Roll the catalog back to this version
